text.config.happier-ghasts.title: Happier Ghasts
text.config.happier-ghasts.option.cruisi: The minimum Y coordinate to start cruising.
Speed multiplier while at cruising altitude.
text.config.happier-ghasts.category.roam: Happy Ghasts will roam around the last player to dismount them, keeping within summoning distance.
text.config.happier-ghasts.option.roamin:
A Happy Ghast roaming around a player will keep a minimum of this this distance from that player.

§eLow values may cause Happy Ghasts to obstruct players.
A Happy Ghast roaming around a player will not stray farther than this distance from that player.
Minimum Happy Ghast speed while roaming around a player.

Maximum Happy Ghast speed while roaming around a player.

§eLow values may lead to Happy Ghasts having trouble keeping up with their targeted player.

A Happy Ghast roaming around a player will stay within this distance of the nearest solid block.

§7Set to 0 to disable.
§7Set to 16 for Vanilla behaviour.
text.config.happier-ghasts.option.tempta:
How far away Happy Ghasts can by tempted from.

§7It's recommended to set this equal to or higher than your Maximum Roaming Distance.
§7Set to 16 for Vanilla behaviour.

How close Happy Ghasts will get while being tempted.

§7Set to 7 for Vanilla behaviour.
How fast Happy Ghasts will move towards a temptation target.

How many ticks for Happy Ghasts to wait after losing a temptation target before they can be tempted again. Due to Mojang code jank, the actual tick delay is equal to this value divided by 2.

§7High values may lead to a generally unresponsive feel that can be annoying.
